question: In September 2026, Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' broke the record for most weeks at number one on America's Billboard Hot 100. The song it overtook, Mariah Carey's 'All I Want for Christmas Is You', had collected its 22 weeks at the top in a very unusual way. How?

Not in a row, across many years

After that it climbed back to the top almost every holiday season and dropped away each January. Its 22 weeks at number one were therefore spread across several separate Christmases, not one long run. 'Choosin' Texas' passed that total with its 23rd week on top in September 2026 and stayed for 24 weeks before Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' replaced it on the chart dated October 10, 2026.

question: Tokyo Game Show 2026, held in late September at Makuhari Messe on the coast near Tokyo, drew over 250,000 visitors in four days. Yet the organisers cancelled its planned fifth day. Why?
alternative_answers: Hurricane (accept as the same weather phenomenon)
source_excerpt: Tokyo Game Show 2026 Cancels Day 5 Due to Incoming Typhoon

topicality.rationale: A cancelled event day due to weather is a small news item that goes stale within days.

extra.verification_notes: Trade press confirms CESA cancelled the Sept 21 fifth day of TGS 2026 because of an approaching typhoon, and four-day attendance was 257,642 (https://finalweapon.net/2026/09/19/tokyo-game-show-2026-cancels-day-5-due-to-incoming-typhoon/).

explanation: Tokyo Game Show 2026 ran from 17 to 20 September at Makuhari Messe in Chiba and drew 257,642 in-person visitors. Late summer and early autumn is peak typhoon season in Japan, and a seaside convention centre packed with crowds is exactly what organisers don't want open during a storm.
